values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 25 Spring Canyon sites (23 electric, 2 basic; site numbers 1-42 with gaps), bookable up to 180 days ahead and at least 1 day before arrival. Whether the unlisted site numbers are first-come is not stated on the booking site.

booking.source: https://nebraskastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/swanson-sra/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NE&parkId=234151 (Booking Window: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 180 Day(s) in advance'; site list, loop Spring Canyon, all pages 2026-10-20)

values.note: ReserveAmerica's Swanson SRA campground facility (Lake View, Macklin Bay and Spring Canyon loops) says 'Status: Open year round', with sites bookable through the winter. Winter water/showerhouse service is not stated.

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 234151 (2026-10-20): all 23 Spring Canyon electric sites list 50 amp

facilities.source: https://nebraskastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/swanson-sra/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NE&parkId=234151 ('59 campsites with 50 amp capabilities, 3 showerhouse/modern restrooms'; amenities: Dump Station, Showers), read 2026-10-20

note: Modern electric loop at Swanson Reservoir SRA near Trenton: 50-amp sites, modern restrooms and showers, dump station; shaded sites set back in the canyon (the sandy-beach primitive areas are separate loops). Reservable on ReserveAmerica up to 180 days ahead (25 Spring Canyon sites listed in 2026). Park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: Changed booking from FCFS-only (derived from a --Claude note) to reservable on ReserveAmerica: 180-day window, at least 1 day ahead; fcfs cleared because the booking site does not say. Confirmed 50-amp electric, showers, dump. Added year-round per RA. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Sites count 47 left (RA lists 25 reservable Spring Canyon sites; no page gives the loop total). RA lists every site at 40 ft, which looks like a default, so max_rig_ft not written. outdoornebraska.gov blocks automated reads (Cloudflare 403).
